description: This file contains code generation logic for autograd view and inplace or view types in PyTorch, including functions for emitting view functions, handling differentiability, and generating registration code.

methods.name: is_tensor_type
methods.description: Checks if a type is tensor-like and not list-like.

methods.name: is_tensor_list_type
methods.description: Checks if a type is tensor-like and list-like.

methods.name: unpack_args
methods.description: Unpacks arguments for a NativeFunction, generating code for tensor argument handling.

methods.name: get_base_name
methods.description: Retrieves the base name of a NativeFunction.

methods.name: get_view_info
methods.description: Gets view information for a function if it is a view function.

methods.name: emit_view_func
methods.description: Generates code for a view function lambda to recover views in backward pass.

methods.name: emit_view_body
methods.description: Generates code for handling view outputs, including differentiability considerations.

methods.name: modifies_arguments
methods.description: Checks if a function modifies its arguments.

methods.name: emit_inplace_or_view_body
methods.description: Generates code for inplace or view function bodies.

methods.name: gen_formals
methods.description: Generates formal argument list for a function.

methods.name: inplace_or_view_method_definition
methods.description: Generates method definition code for inplace or view functions.

methods.name: inplace_or_view_method_registration
methods.description: Generates registration code for inplace or view functions.

methods.name: use_derived
methods.description: Determines if a function should use derived dispatch strategy.

methods.name: gen_inplace_or_view_type_env
methods.description: Generates environment dict for codegen of inplace or view type.

methods.name: gen_inplace_or_view_type
methods.description: Main function to generate the inplace or view type source files with sharding.
